status: research only; no current production mutation
kind: Game skill description reproduced by community guide plus its mechanics analysis; not our own game test

observations.burst: The current guide explicitly includes full-burst bonuses and entry buffs; this supports the authored opt-in timing over the early demo article, but does not establish an exact animation frame.
observations.consumption: Lower ghost branch consumes6 and has a minimum remainder1; upper13 branch consumes9, leaving4.
observations.zero_boundary: Guide says six hits still occur at0 ghosts and a minimum1 is retained; test0 explicitly rather than assuming a reserve can never increase the resource.
observations.capture: Only hits against a possessed enemy or killing that enemy count toward capture; raw data uses squad ammunition as an approximation.
observations.recapture: At cap13, a capture attempt causes the overflow attack; possession is applied every6seconds and cleared after a successful capture.

next_common_requirements: Per-operation consumption floor, distinct from a global minimum resource value
No synthetic capture or ammo events caused merely by clamping a consumed resource
Target-associated hit counter and marker lifetime/removal; distinguish ammo fired from actual target hits
Separate cast-time gate and hit-count snapshot from landing buffs; retain existing partial support fail-closed until all required forms implemented
do_not_claim: Neither pure CPU parity nor accepting possessed as an inert name proves the whole character. Keep rejection until the approximation is corrected or its explicit model boundary is surfaced.
